nom: celimax The Vita-A Retinol Wrinkle Smoothing & Pore Tightening Serum

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with self-described super sensitive, acne-prone skin reports the serum cleared adult acne without irritation.
segments.combination: No distinct combination-skin reports beyond general acne and breakout mentions, so nothing specific can be said for this type.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports forehead wrinkles almost gone after two months of use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes a visible difference on dark spots and small spots after overnight use.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers report breakouts and adult acne clearing, one within less than a week during an active breakout.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no irritation despite a brief tingling sensation on application.

aspects.libelle: Comparable or preferable to Paula's Choice

extraits.texte: Been using this for 2 months now and Wow! My forehead wrinkles are almost gone They were pretty bad before and now you can hardly notice. I will definitely re-buy and highly recommend this product. 10/10
I have super sensitive skin and have dealt with adult acne. This product got rid of my acne and my skin has never looked or felt better!
This retinol serum is amazing! Absorbs quickly with no residue and my skin is so smooth and soft

I tried using this pretty regularly during an active breakout and it's cleared it in less than a week. It can feel a bit spicy going on but doesn't leave my skin irritated once it's on. When I put it on at night, I've noticed a difference in the morning, especially on dark spots and small spots.

reserve: Only six reviews are available and all are 5-star, so segment and concern coverage is thin and no critical review could be included.
